dataset.name: Slovenian distance toll (DarsGo)
dataset.method: Cenik cestnine za uporabo cestninskih cest (Uradni list RS, št. 47/25), with its annex: infrastructure charge per toll section, toll class and EURO class, in euros excluding VAT (22% VAT is charged on the toll); Sklep o uvedbi pribitka k cestnini na določenih odsekih cestninskih cest (... 46/25), NPB 8, art. 2 and 3; Uredba o cestnini za uporabo cestnega predora Karavanke (Uradni list RS, št. 109/24), art. 3. Read from PISRS (pisrs.si); each act's date of application from its register data. Section places and lengths as in the 2026 table (Uredba o cestninskih cestah in cestnini, Annex).
dataset.publisher: carbon-cost (majidkabir/carbon-cost), compiled from the sources listed

sources.title: Cenik cestnine za uporabo cestninskih cest (Uradni list RS, št. 47/25), with its annex
Sklep o uvedbi pribitka k cestnini na določenih odsekih cestninskih cest (... 46/25), NPB 8
Uredba o cestnini za uporabo cestnega predora Karavanke (Uradni list RS, št. 109/24), art. 3

vehicles.description: Motor vehicles over 3.5 t technically permissible maximum mass: R2 two axles, R3 three, R4 more than three

network.description: The DARS motorway and expressway network, 128 toll sections; a section is charged when the route passes both of its ends. The Karavanke tunnel's Slovenian toll is a fixed amount per passage (Uredba o cestnini za uporabo cestnega predora Karavanke (Uradni list RS, št. 109/24), art. 3: R2 4.85, R3 5.38, R4 10.76 EUR excluding VAT).
